label: Envisioning Cards
description: Creates prompt cards that test stakeholders, time scales, values, and diffusion, helping teams critically review long term ethical effects early.

text_output_forms.primary_template: four question-card clusters, evidence prompts, and a workshop check-out question

required_blocks.title: Stakeholder cards
required_blocks.purpose: Ask who is absent, burdened, or made responsible.

required_blocks.title: Time cards
required_blocks.purpose: Move between immediate, delayed, long-term, and post-adoption effects.

required_blocks.title: Value cards
required_blocks.purpose: Expose a value conflict rather than choose a value for the group.

required_blocks.title: Diffusion cards
required_blocks.purpose: Ask what changes if the proposal becomes ordinary, mandated, or widely copied.

required_blocks.title: Workshop check-out
required_blocks.purpose: End with one question about what evidence or change is needed before proceeding.

text_output_forms.presentation_rule: Questions must remain open and actionable. Do not replace the cards with recommendations or a solved ethics verdict.

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf pages 18-19. External design ethics/design research tool.

model_constraints: Use cards as prompts for reflection, not as final answers.
Cover stakeholders, time, values, and technology pervasiveness or diffusion.
Force attention to people, effects, and time scales the input may ignore.
Phrase outputs as review prompts suitable for a workshop or concept critique.
For text outputs, return the package text_blocks sequence as separate question-card clusters; do not answer the questions for the group.

ui.short_description: Create ethical and long-term review prompts.

recommendation.reason: Envisioning Cards are best represented as question prompts, ethical review cards, or checklists that force reflection across stakeholders, time, values, and diffusion.
best_when: The input is a concept, prototype, generated scenario, or design proposal that needs ethical review.
The user needs workshop prompts or critique questions.
The next step is discussion rather than artifact production.

multimodal: card text plus visual card layout specification

avoid: finished scenario with no reflective questions
image-only cards without usable prompt text

warnings: Use after or around another generated concept; it is an evaluation and reflection layer.
